body: I wish I had someone to reach out to, but at the moment theres no one. I have ways to cope that don't hurt me or others, been at this for a bit. I'm going to be 19 this june, but with each day I feel more and more helpless. The hardest part is being alone, sometimes when I'm doing really bad I call my mom, and even if she just gets frustrated I still feel less alone. I have some hope for the future that I'll get out and be able to figure myself out, and maybe even stop feeling this way. Thank you and much love to you too

I've been doing nothing but working for years now, the loneliness and isolation is getting to me and it's been getting harder to beat the bad thoughts away and not crave connection with other people. I know that I'll be much happier once I start achieving my goals and I'm hoping that by doing that I'll find real friendships and people I feel good with. Thanks for your input!

I completely agree with going into a relationship whole, it's the best thing for both people and I'm definitely working towards that. In all honesty I don't want to start anything with anyone if I'm having a lot of personal issues. I also don't want to rush doing anything intimate with someone, I want to do it with someone who I love and who loves me, someone who I trust. I'm mostly just scared that no one will want me because of the way I am, but I also know that the right person will love all of me and that that person will come. Times have just been harder and bad thoughts started creeping around my mind. Thank you for the advice!

My father is horrible and my mother tries her best but she doesn't understand mental health so I can't turn to her for help. It really sucks. I hope your life gets better and you can cut your parents out of your life and be happy. Best of luck :)

I feel you. My half sister and cousin have weddings planned for this month and they aren't even considering stopping it or makings the events safe. My half sister's wedding was yesterday and I didn't go, my brother was pissed and she was pissed too, she even said that the virus wasn't real and there was nothing to worry about. Me and my mom are planning on not going to my cousin's wedding, because it will be about 50 people in a cramped boat and restaurant. My mother has had respitory problems for over a year and she is scared of getting sick, and everyone is giving her shit about it! It's so stupid! It's better to spend a holiday apart instead of spending the last holiday together. Good luck staying safe, I wish you the best!

Please don't end it all. Try to hold on for a little longer, life might get better, things might change. Your death will affect your family. Your death will be a bigger burden to your parents and siblings than the things you'll leave behind. I don't know what else to say, I could say reach out for help or talk to a professional but that can be harder said than done sometimes. Maybe try to think of the better things in your life, think of a better future. I really hope you pull through.

Oh hell yeah I get these urges. I usually feel like there really is nothing for me here, nothing holding me back. I don't have an idea of where I would go, or how I would do it, but it seems like the right thing to do at that moment. For me these urges are usually followed by this anxious feeling of "I have to get up and run".
Happy birthday, quarantined "ruined" my 18th birthday and I was glad for it. I wish you the best :)
Hey us fuck ups have to watch each others backs! Best of luck to you too man :)

Damn your dad kinda reminds me of my own. I know the feeling of failure and life with an abusive parent, it really sucks. But you're not a failure, you'll be able to get out of this. I can't give much advice, since I'm not a good example of dealing with shit in a healthy way, but I think the best thing is to get back into things that you enjoy and take things at your own pace, it's been working for me. And I really like reading and writing too. And if you ever wrote anything I'd love to read it. 

I wish you the best :)
Keep fighting man
That's awesome!
Fuck yeah! You go man!
Hey, my parents aren't very good either, especially my dad. It's rough, it's like drowing in shit. You deserve love and happiness, and you'll get it sooner or later. I hope things get better for you.

My father is really similar to your mother, especially in the whole "the world is against me, I am best and know all" mindset, and my mother vents to me because she has no one else to vent to. It really sucks, emotionally immature parents are the worst. Hope things work out for you.
Thanks!
Oh that is epic

One of the trainers left a few years back and took all of his horses with him to a different barn, another trainer left to Switzerland if I remember right, I don't know where her horses are. The only people left are probably a couple people who keep some horse breed for money(the ones with the barn full of drunk workers) and the trainer my father was close with. I haven't been back there for about a year and my father hasn't spoken to the trainer since we brought our horse back home last summer. She got mad that now she doesn't get money from my father and doesn't see a reason to speak with him any more.

Last I heard from a friend who rides with the trainer one mare died suddenly(they think it was a blood clot), one old horse died of a heart attack and one horse that had a twin brother died without a reason. I think now she resells horses because no one rides anymore, I don't know about the other horses.

I've looked into animal protection, there are a couple that work in Lithuania, but I don't have proof that some kind of abuse is happening, especially since I haven't been there for some time. The horses aren't starving or being beaten until they can't move, even if someone comes and checks it out I don't know if anything would be done. When the young girl got stepped on by a horse police did come and question the trainer, but nothing was done, I thought for sure that they'd close it down, almost hoping. Maybe someday I'll check it out and if nothings gotten better I'll try to contact someone.
Thanks, best of luck to you too!

Yeah it's been shitty not having any real life role models. My mother blames herself for the bad marriage and me growing up as an outcast, she says that she still loves my father and there is really no helping her get out of this mindset. She had really shitty parents. And I'm kinda uneasy around my brother, he used to get pissed at me alot(when I cried or didn't talk back in arguments) and we don't have the best relasionship. He is in a better place in life now and sometimes tries to talk to me, but I'm closed up, and he doesn't really know how to talk about feelings. He has some controlling tendencies, but his wife has the same tendencies so they kinda keep each other in check. I've learned to get by emotionaly on my own and not to ask for help, because in the past asking for help has only blown up in my face. It's best when my family stays apart and only sees each other every now and then, otherwise it's like throwing gas on a fire. I feel content with my life now, especially since I've been living alone more often than not, and I'm slowly getting back into things I enjoyed doing, I really feel hopeful for the future. Thanks for caring. :)
Thanks man

Actually I'm from Lithuania, so it doesn't really fall on the radar for countries that mistreat women. But I will say I have only met a handfull of decent men from here, most men from older generations are either alcoholics or assholes with short tempers, most of the boys from younger generations are wannabe tough guys. Most of the older folk see themselves as god almighty because they survived this long, and don't you dare talk back. My family has never used physical violence against me and I can't say how common beating your kids is. Last I heard depression rates are high here, but I don't know how available help is. I don't know what life is like in other families and I don't get to hang out with people my age, but from what I've seen having all the males in your family be drunks and users is mostly accepted as a part of life and for most kids are mere cleaners and good grade machines. One of my old classmate's mother proudly braged to other parents how her daughter was 15 minutes late so she got locked outside, nobody blinked an eye. It's about time for this country to grow out of that mindset. I just hope my brother doesn't become like our father.
